subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrowed per-spawn `announceTarget:"parent"` contract, where requester wakeup is internal and failure never falls back to the external channel?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but an opt-in delivery mode that can intentionally leave a completion externally unseen is a product-policy choice requiring owner intent.

options.title: Accept per-spawn routing
options.body: Approve the explicit opt-in route, durable in-flight state, and no-channel-fallback behavior after current-head proof.

options.title: Require visible recovery
options.body: Keep the argument but define an owner-approved fallback or diagnostic path when requester wakeup fails.

options.title: Defer native routing
options.body: Retain the existing implicit delivery policy and continue using explicit callback workflows.

recommendation.title: Accept per-spawn routing
recommendation.body: Approve the explicit opt-in route, durable in-flight state, and no-channel-fallback behavior after current-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history covers both the public spawn interface and the requester-session delivery boundary involved in this decision.
